jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Absolute Business Solutions Corp (ABSC) is not just another tech company. We’re a community of innovators, engineers, analysts and business professionals working together with our customers to tackle the most complex challenges. For more than 20 years we’ve supported critical Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), Federal Civilian missions and global, multi-national corporations. We specialize in supporting our clients in the Intelligence, Technology, Defense, AI/ML, and Data Science fields. As we continue to grow at a rapid pace, we need some amazing new professionals to join our team.

ABSC has an exciting opening for a TS/SCI-cleared **Senior Product Owner** supporting mission software design, engineering, development, integration, and deployment for DIA-NDOC under the DTP contract. You will own a portion of the task order’s product portfolio, guide application teams, and translate Government roadmap priorities into executable engineering work and delivered mission value.

The 10-year DOMEX Technology Platform (DTP) program modernizes the secure data, application, and infrastructure capabilities supporting DIA’s National Digital Exploitation & OSINT Center (NDOC). The program delivers scalable media processing, data discovery, enrichment, and analytical services that help mission users transform large volumes of digital information into timely, actionable intelligence. Team members work across software development, systems engineering, cybersecurity, platform operations, and mission integration to sustain current operations while delivering the next generation of DTP capabilities.

**Work location and schedule:** Most work is performed onsite at the customer location in Bethesda, MD. A flexible schedule and occasional remote work may be available based on customer requirements and deliverables.

**Security clearance required for this role:** An active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and the ability to obtain and maintain a CI polygrap

jobs.title: Lead Developer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Markets are changing fast: 24/7 trading, crypto, event contracts and tokenized assets are going mainstream. ICE runs some of the world’s largest clearing houses, and we’re evolving the systems behind them for what comes next. You’ll help lead that change.

**Responsibilities**

* Build: Design and ship the services that calculate positions, margin and settlement.
* Launch: Take new products, such as crypto perpetuals and event contracts, to market.
* Run: Own production systems where a wrong number moves real money.
* Lead: Set technical direction, review designs and code, and grow the team.
* Partner: Work directly with Risk, Treasury and Operations on real problems.

**Responsibilities**

* Bachelor’s in computer science or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 6+ years of hands-on Java, including leading or mentoring developers.
* Technical Expertise:
* + Java 21: Algorithms, design patterns, multi-threading, performance tuning.
  + Messaging: Kafka and Kafka Streams, JMS, Protobuf; event-driven microservices.
  + Spring: Framework 6.x / Boot 3.x; REST API design (OpenAPI); Maven or Gradle.
  + Data: Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL, MyBatis, JDBC, JPA; Liquibase.
  + Testing: JUnit 5, Mockito, TestContainers; test-driven development.
  + Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift (Pipelines, GitOps, Operators), Helm.
  + CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD; GitOps workflows.
  + Observability: Micrometer, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Splunk/ELK.
* Problem-solving, attention to detail, clear communication, Agile.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Domain: Futures and options, especially clearing, margin or risk.
* AI tools: Daily use of AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) to design, build, test and refactor, with rigorous review of what they produce.
* Front end: React or Ext JS.
* Architecture: DDD, hexagonal, CQRS, Event Sourcing, Saga, distributed transactions.
* Platform: AWS/Azure/GCP, Terraform, service mesh, Redis/Hazelcast, Spring WebFlux.
